analysis.title: GS Special Situations | Morning Trading Update (17 Nov 2026)
key_insights: The DOJ, not the FTC, will take the lead in the antitrust review of DoorDash's $17 billion purchase of Instacart (DASH/CART), per US officials cited by media. GS says investors will likely see this as a small positive for the deal, and that it is a modest surprise given the FTC's history of reviewing grocery deals, including its 2024 challenge of Kroger/Albertsons.

A senior DOJ antitrust official said the department is open to approving mergers on behavioral commitments instead of asset sales. He pointed to the DOJ's decision this month to clear Fox Corp.'s $22 billion acquisition of Roku. The FTC's No. 2 competition official said behavioral remedies remain 'disfavored and rare' at the FTC, though regulators sometimes have reasons to accept them.

Quebecor proposed a combination with Telus valued at C$31.31 billion (US$21.96 billion), about C$19.45 a share. That is a roughly 60% premium to Telus's Friday close on the TSX. Telus holders would get C$6.35 in cash plus 0.17 Quebecor Class B shares per Telus share.

Quebecor's CEO said he first approached Telus about a deal roughly a year ago and has a tentative meeting with Telus scheduled for next week (Monday, per GS). Quebecor said it is prepared to make commitments to authorities on pricing and employment to secure approval.
BWIN filed its definitive proxy and will hold its shareholder vote on January 6, 2027. The HSR waiting period expired on November 4, 2026. Closing guidance remains the first quarter of 2027.

Merger arb calendar for the week of 11/17: D (VA PUC hearing), IHS (walk date), SYNA (shareholder vote) on 11/17. On 11/18: VRNS (HSR expires), RXO/CHRW (HSR expires), NSC/UNP (STB opposition comments due), VREX (UK FDI expires), LCII/PATK (shareholder vote). SHLA HSR file-by date is 11/19 and CCC preliminary proxy file-by date is 11/20.

Merger arb calendar for the week of 11/23: BRZE and ADT preliminary proxy file-by (11/23), LITE HSR file-by (11/23), OGN EU FSR Phase I expires (11/23), VREX Austria Phase I expires (11/24), SGRY HSR file-by (11/24), VAL/RIG shareholder vote (11/24), MFIC preliminary N-14 file-by (11/25), BMBL inside date and OGN EC commitments filed by (11/26), PEN/BSX EC commitments filed by, TECH Ireland expires, CCC HSR expires and BMBL HSR expires (11/27).
risk_factors: Antitrust review of DASH/CART: the DOJ is taking jurisdiction, and whether it accepts behavioral remedies in this case is not stated in the report.
Quebecor/Telus is an unsolicited proposal. Telus has not agreed, and approval would need Canadian regulators, with Quebecor offering pricing and employment commitments.
